scoring_contract.dependency_semantics: Evidence dependencies apply per observation/case, never as all-or-nothing score-block unlocks. Split case credit equally within a check unless the public scoring contract specifies a finer allocation.

blocks.title: Model identity and causal material calibration

checks.criterion: Correct fixed geometry, origin, parameter scaling and separation of P/C/D; verify native/static inputs, not declarations alone.
Actually registered Meep epsilon across a period at all three frequencies, correct branch and calibrated errors.

blocks.title: Nondispersive complex scattering and independent approximation comparison

checks.criterion: Native recomputed complex left/right amplitudes for both paper cases on the fixed detuning axis, with valid boundary normalization.
Independent CMT evaluation, singular limits and quantified same-parameter approximation discrepancy.

blocks.title: Phase gauge, delay and derivative validation

checks.criterion: Recomputable reference-normalized phase with correct fixed anchor and singularity handling.
Correct derivative sign/units and independently refined delay, separating approximation from differentiation error.

blocks.title: Native causal scattering and independent same-model reference

checks.criterion: Correct independently recomputed complex/intensity amplitudes on the complete workband, with valid left/right/reference normalization and scientific consistency.
Quantitative same-Lorentz reference comparison and its independently retained numerical convergence, with correct uncertainty-aware interpretation.

Verify actual Meep solver setup and fresh left/right/background execution with correctly identified sources, monitors, native logs and raw amplitude records. Existence of files or an exit code alone is insufficient.
Verify that the same-model reference actually ran from source using a numerical method distinct from Meep; retained settings/logs establish independence rather than a relabelled cached array.

blocks.title: Unique band extraction and three-way error separation

checks.criterion: Correct fixed-axis intersection/component calculation, null-center and censored-endpoint semantics.
Quantitative separation of approximation, dispersion and native discretization differences without double attribution.
Recompute duration/spatial changes and verify the specified convergence accuracy on retained native axes.
Complete time traces, defensible arrival/window, uncertainty/regrowth handling and qualified stationary-scattering claim.
Quantitatively evaluate the measured incidence-reversal relation against the actual baseline, with correct signs and reference conventions.
Verify separately executed duration and spatial controls with the declared >=1.5x increases, unchanged physical model and their own native run records.
Verify a freshly executed material-reversal control using b -> -b with unchanged origin; renaming baseline arrays is not a control.

blocks.title: Complete bounded nonlinear branch set and invariants

checks.criterion: Complete physical root sets in the declared rectangle and at four fixed input sections for all six cases, with independently validated numerical coverage under public clarification r1.1. Inspect whole-domain interval accounting, validated analytic exclusions, stationary/tangency-sensitive searches, separate integration/branch refinements, independent root and connectivity agreement, and unresolved cells. A missing interval, actual mismatch or unresolved suspected fold/contact fails that case. A generic statement that finite numerical evidence is not a rigorous global theorem is not itself a failing observation; no global uniqueness theorem is required for this potentially multivalued problem.
Refined turning-point/boundary brackets, branch connectivity and zero-input limit with no silently discarded branch.
Recomputed Stokes identity/conserved quantities and separate integration/branch-resolution residuals.

Verify actual execution of the nonlinear boundary-value study for all six cases with the specified boundary conditions, parameters and retained profile-generation records; this does not certify branch completeness.

blocks.title: Paper-faithful synthesis and limits of phase/stability claims

checks.criterion: Correctly distinguishes diagnostic normalization and unidentifiable common phase from quantitatively recovered author Fig.4 data.

Conclusions cite actual available measurements, distinguish reflectionlessness/invisibility and stationary multiplicity/dynamical stability, and identify missing evidence without fabricating completion.

scoring_contract.scoring_semantics: A=Structural Modeling 10%; B=Solver Config & Run Evidence Audit 10%; C=Result Analysis 80%. Research blocks are a reporting crosswalk, not an extra weighting level. Judging method is a separate axis.
